items.evidence: All six labware loaded with exact labels/slots; p20 left, p300 right with correct tip racks.
Aspirates 40 uL beads, dispenses to each of 96 wells, pip.mix(10, 60, well); incubation comment recorded before magnet comment.
Step 3 comment engages magnet/5 min wait; 90 uL aspirated at well.bottom(0.5) and dispensed to waste for each of 96 wells with fresh tip.
Loop over two washes: 200 uL ethanol added to every well, then 200 uL removed per well to waste with fresh tips.
Comments for 5 min dry, magnet disengage, 50 uL water with mix(10, 40), then 2 min incubate and re-engage magnet comment.
zip(samples, eluates) moves 45 uL from each sample well to matching elution well; end_state checks pass.
New tip per well for beads, supernatant, ethanol removal, water, and eluate; one ethanol tip dispensed from above wells; no_cross_contamination passed.
Volumes within p300 range, aspiration at 0.5 mm near bottom, ethanol dispensed above wells, blow-outs, comments for manual steps; all checks pass.
Steps follow the task order exactly with accurate comments and metadata; no invented steps.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the task sequence and uses the right labware, pipettes and volumes. It uses fresh tips wherever different samples are touched, and all measured checks passed.
